mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 71 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a Waning Crescent moon overhead.
The Verona Fire Department invites residents to an open house on September 19 between 10 AM and 2 PM at 101 Lincoln Street, featuring station tours, fire safety activities, and food.

Today is packed with activities including the downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, plus events at Paddy Mac's and Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they arrested a 34-year-old Madison resident on one count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, with the investigation currently ongoing.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, a local favorite that you can enjoy starting when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
